scenes.narration: Visa doesn't lend you money. It doesn't even make your card. So how does it make billions?
So how did it bring in 40 billion dollars in fiscal 2025?
Visa runs the network in the middle. Every time a card is tapped, Visa earns a small fee for moving that payment, billions of times a year.
And because it's mostly software, about half of that revenue became profit: 20.1 billion dollars.
Visa is a toll booth on the world's spending. No loans, no credit risk, just fees.
